prompt: We've been building our Next.js app for 3 months and have 40+ components but no design system. Colors are hardcoded everywhere, spacing is inconsistent, and every developer uses different patterns. Help me set up a proper code-first design system.

assertions.text: Guides auditing existing 40+ components for patterns and inconsistencies
Extracts design tokens (colors, typography, spacing) from existing codebase
Establishes atomic design structure (atoms, molecules, organisms)
Defines token naming conventions for the team
Creates a refactoring plan to replace hardcoded values with tokens
Produces a design system setup deliverable
